step1_analysis.description: The netlist contains a PMOS differential pair (XM3, XM4) and two parallel NMOS transistors (XM1, XM2). These are likely fragments of a larger block such as a mixer, variable-gain IF amplifier, or demodulator from the 200-MHz receiver described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Power 200-MHz Receiver for Wireless Hearing Aid Devices

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain of the PMOS differential pair.

paper_reported.value: 10 dB to 50 dB (depending on the specific amplifier stage)

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 50µA tail current, each PMOS gets 25µA. W/L = 5µ/0.5µ = 10. Vov ≈ 0.316V, gm ≈ 158µS. With a 20kΩ load resistor, Gain = gm * Rload = 3.16 V/V ≈ 10 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on standard square-law model for SKY130 PMOS devices with the added 20kΩ load in the testbench.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the biased testbench.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current = 50µA. NMOS pair current ≈ 622µA (at Vgs=0.9V). Total current ≈ 672µA. Power = 1.8V * 672µA ≈ 1.2 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the applied gate bias (0.9V) for the NMOS parallel pair and the ideal tail current source.

step3_testbench.description: Biases the PMOS diff pair with a 50uA tail current and 20kOhm loads, and the NMOS parallel pair with a 1kOhm load. Measures DC power and AC voltage gain of the PMOS stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for PMOS Diff Pair and NMOS Parallel Pair
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_7 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 LABEL_NET_9 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* PMOS Diff Pair Bias and Loads
I_tail VDD N7 50u
R1 N1 0 20k
R2 N5 0 20k
V_INP LABEL_NET_7 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
V_INN LABEL_NET_9 0 dc 0.9 ac -1

* NMOS Parallel Pair Bias and Loads
V_N4 N4 0 0
R3 VDD N0 1k
V_IN1 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9
V_IN2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9

.control
op
let total_current = -i(VVDD)
let power = total_current * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10k
* Assuming midband gain is around 10dB, measure bandwidth at 7dB
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=7 fall=1
quit
.endc
.end
